# FreeSurf Post — API

Base URL: https://post.freesurf.tools

Free, open-source cross-posting API. Write once, publish to X, LinkedIn, Facebook,
Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and Bluesky from your own apps.

## Authentication

Two ways to authenticate:

1. **API key** (recommended for apps): send `Authorization: Bearer fsp_live_...`
   or `X-API-Key: fsp_live_...`. Generate and revoke keys in the dashboard
   (API tab). Keys are scoped to your account.
2. **Supabase JWT**: the dashboard's own session token (`Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`).

## Endpoints

- [Post now](#post-now) — `POST /api/post`
- [Schedule](#schedule) — `POST /api/schedule`
- [Scheduled posts](#scheduled-posts) — `GET /api/scheduled`, `DELETE /api/scheduled/:id`
- [Teams](#teams) — `GET /api/teams`, `POST /api/teams`
- [API keys](#api-keys) — `GET /api/keys`, `POST /api/keys`, `DELETE /api/keys/:id`

## Post now

`POST /api/post`

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x", "linkedin"],
  "text": "Hello world",
  "mediaUrls": [],
  "teamId": null
}
```

- `platforms` (required): array of platform keys.
- `text` (required): post body.
- `mediaUrls` (optional): Bundle upload ids (from `POST /api/media/upload`).
- `teamId` (optional): your team id; defaults to your active team.

Response: `{ "id": "...", "results": [{ "platform": "x", "success": true, "postUrl": "..." }], "postedAt": "..." }`

## Schedule

`POST /api/schedule`

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x"],
  "text": "Later post",
  "scheduledAt": "2026-08-31T14:00:00Z"
}
```

`scheduledAt` must be a future ISO 8601 timestamp. Posts publish within ~5 minutes
of that time via a cron worker.

## Scheduled posts

`GET /api/scheduled` — list your scheduled posts.
`DELETE /api/scheduled/:id` — cancel a scheduled post.

## Teams

`GET /api/teams` — list your teams (id, label, is_active).
`POST /api/teams` — create a team (`{ "label": "Personal" }`).

## API keys

`GET /api/keys` — list your keys (metadata only, never the secret).
`POST /api/keys` — create a key (`{ "name": "..." }`); returns the raw key once.
`DELETE /api/keys/:id` — revoke a key.

## Platform keys

| Key       | Platform   |
|-----------|------------|
| `x`       | X / Twitter |
| `linkedin`| LinkedIn   |
| `facebook`| Facebook   |
| `instagram` | Instagram |
| `threads` | Threads    |
| `tiktok`  | TikTok     |
| `youtube` | YouTube    |
| `bluesky` | Bluesky    |

## X metered pricing

X is billed per action: $0.015 for a plain text/media post, $0.20 for a post
containing a URL. We detect links and pass the exact X fees through at cost
(plus Stripe fees/taxes).
